description: This is a backend source code file for the SignUpPage of an online examination system. It handles user registration, including saving user information and profile image upload, and navigates between pages. It directly interacts with a database to insert new user records.

classes.name: SignUpPage
classes.description: The code-behind class for the SignUpPage, managing user registration and navigation in the online examination system.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial loading of the page; currently empty.

methods.name: loginB_Click
methods.description: Handles the login button click, redirecting users to the login page.

methods.name: signUpB_Click
methods.description: Handles registration form submission, including password validation, image upload, and inserting user data into the database.
